config.alterant.title: Alterant
config.alterant.hud.description: Position and appearance of the tool tooltip on your screen. Save to apply; Reset restores defaults.
config.alterant.hud.anchor.description: The tooltip follows this part of the screen when its size or your window changes. Offsets adjust its position; it stays inside the screen.
config.alterant.hud.x.description: GUI pixels from the anchor. Positive moves right; negative moves left. Follows Minecraft's GUI scale.
config.alterant.hud.y.description: GUI pixels from the anchor. Positive moves down; negative moves up. Default: 80 pixels above the bottom.
config.alterant.serum.description: Position and appearance of the card above the targeted block. The card stays in the world and follows your view; Hidden tooltips hide it too.
config.alterant.serum.x.description: Hundredths of a block across your view. Positive moves right; negative moves left. 100 equals one block.
config.alterant.serum.y.description: Hundredths of a block between the block's top and the card's bottom. 100 equals one block. Default: 12.
config.alterant.scale.description: Size of this display. 100% is the original size. Range: 50% to 200%.
config.alterant.opacity.description: 0% hides the background; 100% makes it opaque. Text remains visible.
config.alterant.background.description: Choose the panel color. Background opacity is controlled separately.
config.alterant.shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the text for contrast.
config.alterant.tooltip.description: Basic shows controls and effects. Advanced adds target details.
config.alterant.coating_outlines.descrip: Mark nearby coated blocks while holding a brush or scraper.
config.alterant.surface_preview.descript: Outline the brush's 3×3 surface before applying.
formulation.alterant.growth_inhibitor: Stops natural plant growth and spreading.
formulation.alterant.preserving_sealant: Protects against melting, decay and weathering.
formulation.alterant.structural_stasis: Holds supported shapes and gravity blocks in place.
formulation.alterant.temporal_stasis: Pauses standard ticks and supported transfers.
item.alterant.jar.brush: Offhand: use with a Preserving Brush
item.alterant.preserving_brush.use: Apply the compound in your offhand
item.alterant.preserving_brush.mode: Sneak-use in air to change mode
overlay.alterant.need_compound: Hold a compound jar in your offhand
overlay.alterant.need_serum: Hold a serum dose in your offhand
overlay.alterant.surface_preview: Center first · Some targets may be skipped
item.alterant.scraper.use: Use to scrape a coating. Sneak-use to peel a mask.
overlay.alterant.conditional: * Only when the profile conditions match
overlay.alterant.partial: External systems and absolute-time work may continue
overlay.alterant.details: Hold Sneak for conditions, limits and profiles
item.alterant.quantum_applicator.use: Use: apply time serum from your offhand
item.alterant.serum.applicator: Offhand: use with a Quantum Applicator
formulation.alterant.suspicious_time_ser: Accelerates supported block ticks at a random speed.
config.alterant.gameplay.description: Adjust serums, enchanting, treatment limits and component trades.
config.alterant.gameplay.title: Alterant · Gameplay
config.alterant.gameplay.offline: Join a world to edit. Showing defaults.
config.alterant.gameplay.unavailable: Settings unavailable. Reopen after joining a compatible world.
config.alterant.gameplay.readonly: Only the world owner or an admin can edit.
config.alterant.gameplay.datapack: Using data pack settings. Saving creates a world override.
config.alterant.gameplay.future: Changes affect new applications and offers. Existing serums keep their speed and time.
config.alterant.gameplay.stale: Not saved: settings changed. Review the updated values and retry.
config.alterant.gameplay.invalid: Check outcome speeds, weights, durations and enchanting costs before saving.
config.alterant.gameplay.io_error: Not saved: could not write the settings file.
config.alterant.gameplay.busy: Too many requests. Reopen this screen and retry.
config.alterant.gameplay.enchant_level.d: Minimum level to enchant Time Serum into Suspicious Time Serum.
config.alterant.gameplay.enchant_levels_: Consumed per enchantment. Must not exceed the required level.
config.alterant.gameplay.bookshelves.des: Must have an unobstructed path to the enchanting table.
config.alterant.gameplay.partial.descrip: Allow treatments that leave external clocks, networks or automation partly active.
config.alterant.gameplay.chunk_limit.des: Lowering this limit keeps existing treatments.
config.alterant.gameplay.area_limit.desc: Maximum blocks in a 3×3 application. Range: 1–9.
config.alterant.gameplay.reset.descripti: Remove the world override and discard unsaved edits. Existing treatments and offers stay intact.
config.alterant.gameplay.trades.descript: Changes affect new offers. Existing villagers keep their trades and stock.
config.alterant.gameplay.trade.count.des: Number of components delivered per purchase.
Number of times the offer can be used before the villager needs to restock.
config.alterant.gameplay.trade.end_stone: Set to 0 to charge only emeralds.
config.alterant.gameplay.regular.multipl: Speed of future applications, from 1.01× to 8× on supported tick routes.
config.alterant.gameplay.regular.duratio: Lifetime in ticking chunks. Existing applications keep their saved remaining time.
config.alterant.gameplay.refined.multipl: Speed of future applications, from 1.01× to 8× on supported tick routes.
config.alterant.gameplay.refined.duratio: Lifetime in ticking chunks. Existing applications keep their saved remaining time.
config.alterant.gameplay.enduring.multip: Speed of future applications, from 1.01× to 8× on supported tick routes.
config.alterant.gameplay.enduring.durati: Lifetime in ticking chunks. Existing applications keep their saved remaining time.
config.alterant.gameplay.overcharged.mul: Speed of future applications, from 1.01× to 8× on supported tick routes.
config.alterant.gameplay.overcharged.dur: Lifetime in ticking chunks. Existing applications keep their saved remaining time.
config.alterant.gameplay.suspicious.dura: Lifetime of future Suspicious applications in ticking chunks.
config.alterant.gameplay.outcomes.descri: Choose up to 16 distinct speeds. Chance is each weight divided by the total. A weight of 0 disables an outcome. Roll once when applying; the result stays saved.
config.alterant.gameplay.outcome.multipl: Supported acceleration multiplier, from 1.01× to 8×. Active outcomes must have distinct speeds.
Relative chance; 0 disables this outcome. At least one outcome must have positive weight.
config.alterant.gameplay.outcome.empty: Set at least one positive weight.
item.alterant.reclamation_jar.use: Hold offhand while scraping. Use in air to extract.
item.alterant.masking_strips.use: Use to skip area treatments. Sneak-use to peel; a scraper also works.
feedback.alterant.busy: Wait for this target to finish its current action.
feedback.alterant.range: Move closer to a loaded target.
feedback.alterant.charges: Not enough charges for the whole target.
feedback.alterant.limit: This chunk has reached its Alterant limit.
feedback.alterant.linked_load: Load and reconnect every linked member first.
feedback.alterant.changed: The target or held items changed. Try again.
item.alterant.release_solvent.use: Use to dissolve coatings. One dose per block; no residue.
item.alterant.release_solvent.mode: Sneak-use in air to change mode. Masks skip area release.
feedback.alterant.solvent: Not enough solvent for the whole target.
formulation.alterant.growth_regulator: Allows supported plants to grow to a selected stage or height.
item.alterant.growth_regulator.configure: Use this jar in air to choose a limit for future applications.
feedback.alterant.growth_limit: Choose a limit supported by this plant.
feedback.alterant.growth_past: This plant is already beyond the selected limit.
feedback.alterant.growth_root: Apply height regulation at the root.
item.alterant.shaping_stylus.use: Use to preview; sneak-use the block to commit.
item.alterant.shaping_stylus.payment: New shapes require Structural Stasis offhand.
item.alterant.shaping_stylus.modes: Sneak-use in air: shape, sample, paste.
feedback.alterant.shape_payment: Hold Structural Stasis offhand to shape this block.
feedback.alterant.shape_sample: Sample a matching block shape first.
feedback.alterant.shape_blocked: An entity is in the selected shape.
feedback.alterant.shape_policy: This coating does not preserve the selected shape.
formulation.alterant.transfer_seal: Seals supported item and fluid automation while allowing processing and native inventory access.
item.alterant.transfer_seal.configure: Use this jar in air to choose directions and faces.
feedback.alterant.transfer_unsupported: This block has no supported item or fluid transfer route.
